title: North-East-wide hartal in support of Jaffna University students
notes: Sources document a regional shutdown of businesses, schools, transport and services in support of the Jaffna students. They do not document a separate ≥50-person assembly beyond the campus protest tracked in SRI202101-E001; do not treat closures as turnout or split the Jaffna protest automatically. Daily Mirror also says people in Batticaloa District protested and reports business closures in several towns, but gives no discrete gathering site or attendance estimate; the assembly threshold remains unestablished. The Sunday Times also reports shops, markets and private institutions closing for the hartal, without a separate assembly count. Hiru reported the 11 January hartal as planned with TNA support, and Tamil Guardian recorded Muslim Congress leaders calling supporters to join; these are calls/support for a shutdown, not evidence of a separate qualifying gathering.

title: Port workers' announced ECT work-to-rule campaign
notes: News First reports that workers decided to launch a workplace work-to-rule campaign, but gives no execution date or evidence of a public gathering during January. Retain as a lead for continuity, not an observed event.

title: Kandy protest opposite the Indian Assistant High Commission in support of Indian farmers
notes: News First places this Indo-Sri Lanka People's Cooperation Movement action opposite India's Assistant High Commission and describes it as support for Indian farmers protesting amendments to India's farm laws. No demand to Sri Lanka's government is reported. Event day and attendance are not supplied.
